label: Bird: trigger and manifestation comparison
summary: §§1–3 and §§6–7, pp.259–262 and 268–269: Bird's finks and antidotes test the implication from possession to manifestation in triggering conditions. The old target goes from causing to having power. The understood-capacity disjunction and dormant-power example do not assert the simple possession-to-manifestation implication. No matching case premise was found. A comparison needs a premise fixing the trigger, manifestation, and prohibited blockers.
